entities.summary: Nematollah Nassiri was an Iranian military officer and intelligence chief who served as the third director of SAVAK, the Iranian intelligence agency and secret police during the rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi. He was also the Ambassador of Iran to Pakistan. Nassiri was among the 438 individuals arrested and executed in 1979 following the Iranian Revolution.
